purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical clinic inpatient (nyuin) accounting/billing subsystem within the JMA ORCA standard receipt software
purpose.summary: This program (ORCSNYUACCT) is a subprogram within the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that creates and updates inpatient accounting records. It calculates inpatient treatment points/fees, handles admission/discharge date ranges, processes dietary charges, selected medical fees, and various special additions/reductions, writing results to inpatient accounting master files.

notable_features: Large number of COPY statements (23) using ORCA-specific .INC copybooks
34 CALL statements to ORCA subsystem programs
298 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
REPLACING clause on COPY for record prefix substitution
OCCURS tables for inpatient treatment data
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
LINKAGE SECTION with SPA-AREA (ORCA session parameter area)
verdict.notes: Comments are in Japanese encoded as EUC-JP but decoded as latin-1, producing mojibake in the displayed text. File is 4301 lines and clearly production-grade ORCA system code. Source truncated at 16000 chars but enough structure is visible to classify confidently.
